answer.reason: Sodom's story has two chief events told in the verses: the capture of its goods and people by the eastern kings, and its destruction by fire from the LORD.

clauses.english: was plundered by Chedorlaomer and his allies, who took Lot with the goods
clauses.quote: And they took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.

clauses.english: was overthrown when the LORD rained brimstone and fire on it from heaven
clauses.quote: Then the LORD rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the LORD out of heaven;

doubts: Verses where Sodom is only a comparison or a warning (Isaiah, Jeremiah, Matthew, Luke, Jude, Revelation and others) were not used as events of the city itself.
REV 11:8 uses Sodom as a figurative name for another city, so it was left out.
